text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah... 
It smells like autumn.

Today, I brought Daring Tact to a nature 
park with an obstacle course just outside 
the Kanto region. 
The goal, of course—
choice_data_list:
Let's unwind and refresh to your heart's 
content in nature!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah... but is this really alright? 
Shouldn't I be focusing on training right 
now—
choice_data_list:
If you're not going, then excuse me while 
I head out first!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Wait, Tore-san—
choice_data_list: Alright, hide-and-seek it is! Farewell!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what...!? 
Tore-san...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Please wait!
choice_data_list: Found! Onto the next spot...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! 
...Tore-san—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —Hup!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Um, could we stop playing hide-and-seek? 
I don't think it's possible to escape from 
me in the woods...
choice_data_list:
(Admittedly, that might've been a bit 
reckless...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Bungee jumping... So you put on safety 
gear 
and leap from here, right?
choice_data_list: Th-that's quite a height...
Th-that's quite a height...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Actually, from this height, 
I think I could manage even without the 
gear.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The river looks deep enough, and I don't 
see any rocks. 
The wind direction is favorable too... As 
long as I cushion the impact when hitting 
the water—
choice_data_list:
No, no, no, absolutely not, are you 
crazy?!

No, no, no, absolutely not, are you 
crazy?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I-I'm sorry. 
I was joking, of course...!
choice_data_list: A joke?! Oh thank goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm truly sorry... 
...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—Once you prepare the fire striker and 
flint like this...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Strike the spark toward the tinder!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, awesome!" "It's Fireman!" 
"Fireman!" "Do it again!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Well then, 
shall we try doing it together, everyone?
choice_data_list:
(...Phew, looks like she's finally 
loosened up.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Oh, how lovely...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, look, swans! 
And it looks like... they're a pair.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Oh, would it be alright if I sketched 
them? 
I brought my sketchbook along!
choice_data_list: Of course, take all the time you need.
Of course, take all the time you need.

text_block_list.text:
Her pen moved relentlessly as Daring Tact 
gazed at the swans with focused eyes. 
Peeking over from the side—
choice_data_list: (She's good... or rather, incredible?!)

text_block_list.text:
Instead of drawing simple outlines, she 
grasped their skeleton and musculature, 
layering form over them. The swans looked 
as if they might flap their wings right 
off the page—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, looking good.
choice_data_list: You're amazingly talented at this!
You're amazingly talented at this!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. 
...Hehe.
choice_data_list: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking about everyone back 
home. 
Much like you do now, Tore-san, 
they always gave me unconditional praise.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Whenever there was something I wanted to 
see or sketch, 
someone would take me out right away. 
Saying, "Anything for Daring Tact"...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Everyone was truly so kind...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...I miss them.
choice_data_list: Do you want to go back home?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
No. 
...No, I certainly don't mean that.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I made up my mind when I left 
that I wouldn't return until I achieved 
real results.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...It's just, the wind that blows there... 
I miss it dearly.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The wind here in the city is broken and 
fleeting... 
Blocked by the crowds, it never reaches 
you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The people living in the city all seem so 
dignified and confident... 
Standing tall even without a wind at their 
backs.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...It's not that I've lost my pride. 
The land of Hidaka is truly wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yet here... 
my heartbeat feels completely drowned out.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Compared to everyone else, 
I'm... so unreliable, aren't I?
choice_data_list: That's not true at all. In fact—

text_block_list.text:
I'm about to tell her how breathtaking her 
brilliance is, 
straight from the heart... but I hesitate 
for a split second. 
What if having such high expectations—
choice_data_list: (Turns into crushing pressure...?)

text_block_list.text:
Right now, she's already intimidated 
by the fierce talent around her. Wouldn't 
it be better 
to offer gentle encouragement first—
Just then.

Suddenly... words spoken to me in the past 
flashed across my mind.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...That girl is stronger than you think. 
Have a little faith in her."

Those were the words Daring Heart gave me 
right after the Debut race. Back then, 
I wondered why she felt the need to say 
it, but—
choice_data_list: (...Right, how could I forget?!)
(...Right, how could I forget?!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Tore-san, please tell me once more. 
—Can I really make the cut here at Tracen 
Academy?

When I first met her back in Hokkaido, 
what moved me most was her unwavering 
inner strength— 
that pure, earnest brilliance.

Ever since arriving in the city, she had 
certainly wavered. 
Yet at her core... 
she was a girl who could withstand any 
pressure.
choice_data_list: Daring Tact, I believe in your potential.
Daring Tact, I believe in your potential.

text_block_list.text:
She could achieve great things on any path 
she took. 
She could become a Derby horsegirl, and if 
she 
ran the Tiara route—
choice_data_list:
You could even become a Triple Tiara 
horsegirl!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara... 
A historic feat that only five have 
accomplished 
in the long history of the Twinkle 
Series...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...If I could achieve that... 
it would prove the strength of Hidaka.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I know you can do it.
Yes, I know you can do it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Is it because I am your trainee 
that you say such things to me?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Like a parent seeing limitless potential 
in their child... 
Do you truly believe—that I can do it?
choice_data_list:
No, this is my genuine faith in you as 
your trainer.

No, this is my genuine faith in you as 
your trainer.

text_block_list.text:
I signed a contract with Daring Tact 
because I knew 
without a doubt that she is an incredible 
horsegirl. With her— 
we can leave a mark on history unlike 
anything seen before.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Now, all that's left is for me... 
to grow strong enough to be worthy of that 
faith.
choice_data_list: ...In that case, let's put it to the test.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Love me♡ Love you♡ 
Loves Only You is here♡

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright! 
Can I run a full mile today?!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: P-Pleased to be running with you today...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Tore-san... 
Um, could today be—
choice_data_list: Yeah, a mock race against these three!
Yes, a mock race against these three!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact, I've been curious about that 
nature-bred 
talent of yours. 
—Come on, show us what you've got!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Tore-san... Do you truly think 
that the current me can beat those three?
choice_data_list: Don't you think you can?
Don't you think you can?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Well, that's.

I understand how difficult it will be. 
Even so, 
what she needs right now is— 
the tangible feeling that she can truly do 
this.
choice_data_list: Where did you come from, Daring Tact?
Where did you come from, Daring Tact?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I came from...—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis and the Others
text_block_list.text:
—HAAAAAAAAAAAH...!! 
—YAAAAAAAAAAAH...!! 
—HAAAAAAAAAAAHHH...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(Such fierce spirit...! Feeling it up 
close 
makes the goosebumps rise on my skin...!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Even so, even so...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(I, too... survived and thrived 
in that harsh wilderness—)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—A horsegirl from Hidaka is strong...!! 
HAAAAAAAAAAAH...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? 
Did I...

Daring Tact held her ground magnificently, 
sinking her teeth in and keeping pace 
right alongside 
the Classic-class horsegirls leading the 
front lines.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact! 
You were incredible!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Especially that late burst... Simply 
magnificent! 
If we compare it to recent races... yes, 
that Tokyo—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for giving it your all against 
us! 
—You're really strong, Daring Tact!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Tore-san... 
I feel like I was able to run with 
complete freedom.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It feels as though I gave more of myself 
than ever before...
choice_data_list: All that hard conditioning paid off.
All that hard conditioning paid off.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, so that was it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Back then, my vessel wasn't ready... 
I didn't have what it took to unleash my 
true strength.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Believing that my limits lay far beyond 
that, 
you trained me, Tore-san...
choice_data_list: No more doubts now, right?
No more doubts now, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, thank you very much. 
Thanks to you, I remembered.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I have always... 
grown stronger in proportion to the faith 
placed in me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Tore-san. My dream is 
to prove the greatness of my hometown.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—By etching my name into history 
as a Triple Tiara horsegirl!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's make it happen!
Yes, let's make it happen!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. 
Looks like you won't be needing me for a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Keep going just like that! 
My pure, straightforward rookie team!
